reasons.action: No requested new action, behavior, vocal performance or locomotion is specified; the request only combines body and wheel sources into one subject.
reasons.medium: The medium decision preserves the live-action rendering and pins the medium owner to the reference; no restyling or rendering transformation is requested.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is requested; the body/wheel combination is resolved through target identity, not wardrobe authority.
reasons.lighting: No instruction about illumination, light sources, direction or visible light quality is given, so the reference lighting governs.
reasons.framing: No camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or camera movement is requested; combining source parts into one subject is not a framing instruction.
reasons.palette: No color grading, saturation or tonal contrast treatment is requested, so the reference palette governs.
